source: assets-model/s07_future_v2.blend (Workflow v2, live Blender; built by assets-model/scripts/s07_future_v2.py build())
review: Muse APPROVED pass1 2026-11-17 (nami-muse-inbox captures/S07-BL/pass1/review.md); blockout pass2 fixes verified (robot planted, trail continuous)
units: metres; glTF +Y up; robot stands on the rock at y=0 (root sunk 0.06 so the dome bottom rests in the rock)
tris_note: scene only (rocks decimated to 45% on export); robot is the runtime model (~39k) -> ~72k with robot, budget 100k
size_note: ~5 MB, mostly the embedded s07_sky_city.png matte painting; compress to KTX2/WebP in the build step

backdrop.note: shadeless card fitted to the hero camera frustum at 900 m; UVs preserve hero frame coordinates and extend to [-0.3, 1.3] on the expanded card with mirrored repeat. Shader grade (Blender only): zenith x0.36 above frame y 0.30, bottom-right cloud corner x0.34. Reproduce in three.js as a MeshBasicMaterial with the same gradient multiply, or bake the grade into the image; exclude from fog and depth-write

robot.pose: rest pose (arms down), back to camera facing the city
robot.runtime_note: ref robot carries a green N on its back (RB-ROBOT)

rock_note: albedo in vertex colour COLOR_0 (moss/lichen); the Blender bump is procedural and not exported - add a tiling rock normal map at runtime

logo.note: M_Glass_N: semi-transparent mint glass (alpha ~0.6) + fresnel emission #2FE3A2; rims are additive emissive tubes (front 5.0, back 0.5)

orbit.note: additive emissive; ring 4.0, arcs 2.2 - candidates for a slow runtime spin

trail.note: additive emissive; core #2FE6C8 0.55, halo #19C37D 0.25; traced to the ref frame path at y=-30 (bay level)

runtime_shaders: M_Trail/M_Trail_Halo/M_Orbit_S07/M_Orbit_Arc/M_N_Rim_* are additive (AdditiveBlending, depthWrite false); M_Glass_N transparent; M_Sky_City unlit
lighting: none exported; lit in three.js. Blender review look: Standard, no look, Glare bloom; sun (warm 1.0,0.70,0.45, energy 14, from the right at 10 deg elevation, az toward the sun 45 deg right of +Y-forward), cool fill area 300 W from camera-left, world dusk blue 0.10,0.14,0.20 x2. Sun excluded from the N and robot ear discs/face; fill excluded from the tree. No world haze volume (EEVEE world volume blocks the sun)
html_overlay: title, subtitle, 4 service cards, 2 buttons and nav are HTML over the calm sky band x 0.33-0.90, y 0.10-0.70
open_notes: robot reads flatter/whiter than the ref (117%) - runtime robot materials
ref N slightly more luminous inside + faint light column under it
ref rock tops catch more warm sun
no near cloud wisps (clouds come from the matte)
curve-derived mesh data carries .00N suffixes (node names are clean)

mo2a_jump6_camera.description: MO-2f round 9: 4 m approach from a 2.5 m camera-right and 0.75 m camera-down offset, fixed hero orientation; linear cubic Bezier
